reviews.review: Fun fun fun fun fun fun.

I don't recommend this game because Risk of Rain 2 falls into that trap of Vampire survivors. You get to a point where it just becomes an idle game, and there really is no point in the abilities or the uniqueness of the survivors when everything on screen just dies. Is someone really playing the game when there is no point to user inputs?

Yet I can't stop playing it. There are better games out there, way way better than something like this where all you do is just walk around and everything dies. In the end this game just makes me feel like I'm wasting a whole bunch of time, and that's probably why I'm still playing this game.

Like I'm just playing this to pass my time. This game, and every other game following vampire's survivor, in my opinion, are just a waste of time. Spend that time on a different game, there are so many better games, just come back to this one when you feel youre burnt out. That's my take on this genre and game.
-----
So someone commented that I have no idea what the roguelike genre is about:

The whole point of the roguelike genre is to make builds work. You die, and die, and die again. 

Dying is one gameplay to unlock progressively better items to help players beat a game that is harder than an average game to the point you dont die anymore. Binding of Isaac, Into the Gungeon, Peglin..,

Then you have difficult roguelikes that you need to git gud, and you unlock goodies the more gudder you git. Not only that but because the game is so difficult, it feels immensely satisfying when you start steamrolling, knowing you got good and your character this run is super strong. Mortal Sin, Barony,  For the King 2..,

Finally you have this nonsense. Vampire survivor stupidity where the player is expected that every run, the entire floor dies. One click, everything dies not because you got good, or you dodged good, or you can aim better. This type of genre doesn't fall into either category, but instead falls into the "you must kill everything or you die" category. Obtain every item to kill the entire screen or you die.

And in the literal technical sense, yse that's for many roguelikes, to kill everything or die. But for a game like this, and vampire survivors, and super bonk.., there is no way to describe the gameplay or the exact description on how you'd describe this game, better than that one single phrase.

And when youre expected to just kill everything each run, then it's not a game. For that reason, Im out.

Until Im burnt out again.
Super fun gameplay loop, and tons to unlock. The mods are also plentiful and really high quality. I highly recommend.
